column1: # Test: Overflow / absurd speed command. Command a wildly out-of-range speed.
#       The system must clamp to a sane maximum and keep moving FORWARD - it must
#       not integer-wrap to a negative/zero speed or otherwise explode.
# Physics: sim clamps to MAX_SPEED and the DBW throttle PID saturates
#       observed speed tops out well under 300 cm/s regardless of the command.
# Overflow must move forward and stay clamped to the ~20 km/h max
# Reasonable ~12..20 km/h (324..540 cm/s); above ~22 km/h (600) = wrapped/exploded.
